scene.ar: اليوم أول جمعة لك. يتصل بك صديقك صباحًا ليتفق معك على الذهاب، وتصلان إلى المسجد والإمام قد بدأ الخطبة.
scene.en: Today is your first Friday. A friend calls in the morning to go together, and you reach the mosque just after the imam has begun the sermon.

say.ar: إذا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ: أَنْصِتْ، يومَ الجمعةِ، والْإِمامُ يَخْطُبُ، فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ
say.en: If you say to your companion 'listen' on Friday while the Imām is delivering the sermon, you have thus engaged in idle talk

why.ar: فَاسْتَمَعَ وَأَنْصَتَ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَزِيَادَةُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ
why.en: listens to it attentively and keeps silent, his sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days

when.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower

text.ar: صباح الخير! سأمرّ عليك قبل الظهر. هل استعددت؟
text.en: Good morning! I'll pick you up before noon. Are you getting ready?

quote.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower

text.ar: نعم، سأغتسل وأتجهز؛ جاء في الحديث:
text.en: Yes, I'll take a shower and get ready. The hadith says:

quote.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower

text.en: Yes, I'll be ready on time.

text.ar: سأذهب بملابس الرياضة بعد التمرين مباشرة.
text.en: I'll come straight from the gym in my sports kit.

text.ar: (تدخلان والإمام يخطب، فيهمس لك طارق:) اجلس هنا.
text.en: (You go in while the imam is speaking, and Tariq whispers:) Sit here.

quote.en: Get up and pray two Rak‘ahs
listens to it attentively and keeps silent

text.ar: (تصلي ركعتين خفيفتين، ثم تجلس وتنصت للخطبة دون كلام.)
text.en: (You pray two short rak'ahs, then sit and listen to the sermon without talking.)
(You sit straight down and listen to the sermon.)

text.ar: (تجلس وتسأل طارق بصوت منخفض عن معنى ما يقوله الإمام.)
text.en: (You sit down and quietly ask Tariq what the imam is saying.)

prompt.ar: دخلت المسجد والإمام يخطب. ماذا تفعل قبل أن تجلس؟
prompt.en: You come in while the imam is giving the sermon. What do you do before sitting?

quote.en: Get up and pray two Rak‘ahs

prompt.ar: قلت لمن بجانبك «أنصت» والإمام يخطب. ماذا يقول الحديث عن ذلك؟
prompt.en: During the sermon you told the person beside you “listen”. What does the hadith say about it?

quote.en: you have thus engaged in idle talk
